00202.trial: Jones et al., 2005, randomized phase III
00202.population: 449 patients with advanced breast cancer progressing after an anthracycline-containing regimen.
00202.applicability: Exact docetaxel100q21 dose/schedule, but anthracycline-pretreated advanced-disease trial population is narrower than the NCCP indication wording.
limitations: Higher treatment-related haematological and non-haematological toxicity with docetaxel; global quality-of-life scores similar.
These are group outcomes, not an individual prediction.
Avoid unlabelled HRs: the publication reports ratios above1 while favouring docetaxel; absolute group outcomes prevent comparator-direction error.
00202.source_type: Primary study; PubMed abstract and where indicated primary full text

00230.trial: Gradishar et al., 2005, randomized phase III
00230.applicability: Exact260q21 schedule; clinical use must still meet NCCP prior-treatment/anthracycline-unsuitability indication.
limitations: Dose, formulation and infusion/premedication differed between arms.
No overall-survival advantage is claimed from this abstract.
Grade3 sensory neuropathy was more frequent with nab-paclitaxel (10% versus2%), while grade4 neutropenia was less frequent (9% versus22%).
Do not transfer these efficacy numbers to weekly100mg/m².
00230.source_type: Primary study; PubMed abstract and where indicated primary full text

00736.trial: Blum et al., 2007, phase II cohorts
00736.population: Metastatic breast cancer after conventional taxane failure: progression during metastatic taxane treatment or relapse within12months of adjuvant taxane.
00736.comparator: Separate125mg/m² cohort (n75), not a randomized conventional-taxane control.
00736.applicability: Exact100mg/m² day1/8/15q28 schedule in later-line taxane-refractory disease; does not directly study the NCCP hypersensitivity substitution population.
limitations: Phase II cohort estimates demonstrate activity; they do not establish superiority or equivalence to another regimen.
The q21 nab260 pivotal trial does not establish this weekly schedule.
Do not borrow the12.9month PFS from the150mg/m² weekly arm of the first-line Gradishar2009 study for this100mg/m² later-line regimen.
Irish off-label consent and local governance apply regardless of study evidence.
00736.source_type: Primary study; PubMed abstract and where indicated primary full text

00743.trial: Ohtani et al., JUST STUDY, 2018, prospective phase II
00743.population: 88 patients with metastatic breast cancer, prior anthracycline/taxane and ≤3 previous metastatic chemotherapy regimens.
00743.intervention: All began standard eribulin1.4mg/m² mesylate (=1.23mg/m² base) days1/8q21.42 moved to days1/15q28 according to toxicity/laboratory criteria.
00743.comparator: 40 continued standard dosing; groups were not randomly assigned.

outcomes.endpoint: Clinical benefit rate, primary endpoint, modified biweekly group
Median time to treatment failure, modified biweekly group

00743.applicability: Direct evidence for tolerance-led conversion to fortnightly eribulin, not universal starting use of day1/15q28.
limitations: Toxicity-based selection and small groups prevent valid equivalence or survival superiority claims.
EMBRACE used days1/8q21; its survival advantage cannot be presented as evidence for the exact fortnightly schedule.
The NCCP28day posology remains unlicensed in Ireland and requires local consent/governance.
Mesylate1.4 and base1.23mg/m² are equivalent expressions, not interchangeable numeric dose entries.
00743.source_type: Primary study; PubMed abstract and where indicated primary full text

00485.applicability: The cited trials support dose density and weekly paclitaxel separately; neither tests the exact entire dose-dense AC→weekly paclitaxel sequence against its comparator.

studies.name: CALGB9741, Citron et al.,2003
studies.population: 2005 women with axillary node-positive early breast cancer; postoperative adjuvant treatment.
studies.design: 2×2 factorial: every2weeks with filgrastim versus every3weeks; sequential A→T→C versus concurrent AC→T.
studies.limitation: Taxane was every2or3weeks, not12weekly doses; no exact00485 whole-regimen absolute survival estimate.

studies.name: E1199, Sparano et al.,2008
studies.population: 4950 women with node-positive or high-risk node-negative early breast cancer.
studies.design: All had AC every3weeks×4 before taxane randomization; weekly paclitaxel80mg/m²×12 compared with paclitaxel175mg/m² every3weeks×4.
studies.limitation: AC was every3weeks, not dose dense; moderate/severe neuropathy was more frequent with weekly paclitaxel (27% versus20%).

limitations: Report study-specific endpoints and populations, not a combined exact-regimen survival figure.
Trial figures are historical group outcomes and do not replace individual prognostic discussion.
